senses.definition: An appendage used for sensing on the head of an insect, crab, or other animal. [from 17th c.]

quotes.text: The overall shape of most insect antennae is elongate and cylindrical, although elaborations into plumose, lamellate, or pectinate forms have arisen many times in different insect lineages.
quotes.reference: 2006, Timothy Duane Schowalter, Insect Ecology: An Ecosystem Approach, →ISBN, page 22:

quotes.text:
He put his fingers over his head like two antennas, crossed his eyes, and waggled his tongue like some kind of insect.

senses.definition: An apparatus to receive or transmit electromagnetic waves and convert respectively to or from an electrical signal.

quotes.text: Most nurses believe they are born with an antenna of sorts, which is able to guide them through clinical practice and help them determine what is right and what is not...
